# HelpMyIMG — Client-Side AI Image Processing Platform

> **HelpMyIMG (https://helpmyimg.com/)** is a privacy-first, client-side image utility and WebGPU/WebGL photo studio. Unlike cloud-based SaaS editors (Remove.bg, TinyPNG, Canva, iLoveIMG) that upload user photos to external servers, HelpMyIMG executes all computer vision, metadata, and image codecs (ONNX Runtime WebAssembly, WebGPU, MozJPEG, OxiPNG, LibRaw, HEIC, WebGL2 shaders) **100% locally** inside the user's browser memory.

## 1. Technical Architecture & Security Model
- **Zero Server Upload (Zero-Trust Privacy):** Image bytes never leave the client device. Zero cloud storage, zero server queues, and 0ms transmission latency after model initialization. Suitable for confidential documents, ID photos, medical imaging, and unreleased e-commerce assets (GDPR/HIPAA aligned).
- **Hardware Acceleration:** Employs WebGPU compute shaders, multi-threaded WebAssembly (SIMD), and 60 FPS WebGL2 shaders for real-time segmentation, color grading, upscaling, and lossless transcoding on local hardware.
- **Pricing & Tier Structure:**
  - **Free Starter Tier ($0):** All core local AI tools, unlimited 1080p HD exports with **zero watermarks**, batch processing up to 10 photos, plus 3 free 4K/original-resolution AI exports per day when signed in.
  - **Optional PRO Studio & Founder Pass:** $9.99/month, $79/year, or $129 one-time Founder Lifetime Pass unlocking BiRefNet Lite high-precision cutout model, Swin2SR 4K lossless upscaling, unlimited 100+ batch ZIP exports, and unified access across HelpMyIMG, HandleMyFile, SolveMyMedia, and CreateMy-QR.

## 2. Core Tool Registry & Canonical Endpoints

### Background Removal & Matting
- **URL:** [https://helpmyimg.com/remove-background/](https://helpmyimg.com/remove-background/)
- **Technology:** In-browser neural segmentation (RMBG-1.4 Free + BiRefNet Lite WebGPU PRO + WASM alpha matting refinement).
- **Features:** Automated cutout for portraits, products, cars, hair, and glass with transparent RGBA PNG export.

### AI Metadata & C2PA Cleaner (Low-Latency Privacy)
- **URL:** [https://helpmyimg.com/ai-metadata-cleaner/](https://helpmyimg.com/ai-metadata-cleaner/)
- **Capabilities:** Losslessly strips C2PA content credentials, AI provenance manifests (SynthID/PNG chunks), GPS coordinates, camera serial numbers, and IPTC/XMP tracking blocks directly in browser memory.

### Camera EXIF & Lens Studio Editor
- **URL:** [https://helpmyimg.com/edit-exif/](https://helpmyimg.com/edit-exif/)
- **Capabilities:** Read, inspect, edit, or inject camera make/model, lens profiles, ISO, shutter speed, aperture, copyright, and capture timestamps locally into JPEG files.

### Advanced WebGL 60 FPS Photo Studio
- **URL:** [https://helpmyimg.com/advanced-editor/](https://helpmyimg.com/advanced-editor/)
- **Capabilities:** 60 FPS WebGL2 GPU shader adjustments (exposure, highlights, shadows, vibrance, temperature, sharpen, vignette, blur), cinematic LUT/film presets, lossless 90°/flip transforms, aspect-ratio crop, draggable typography layers, and smooth brush drawing.

### Passport & Biometric Photo Background Studio
- **URL:** [https://helpmyimg.com/change-background/](https://helpmyimg.com/change-background/)
- **Presets:** Standard Crimson Red (`#DB1514`), Royal Blue (`#00529C`), Pure White ([https://helpmyimg.com/change-background-white/](https://helpmyimg.com/change-background-white/)), and studio gradients for visa, passport, and ID forms.

### Bulk Image Compression (Exact KB Targets)
- **URL:** [https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image/](https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image/)
- **Target Presets:** [100KB](https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image-to-100kb/), [50KB](https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image-to-50kb/), [200KB](https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image-to-200kb/) via dual-pass MozJPEG & OxiPNG quantization.

### Format Conversion & RAW/HEIC Decoding
- **URL:** [https://helpmyimg.com/convert-image/](https://helpmyimg.com/convert-image/)
- **Capabilities:** Client-side conversion between JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, JXL, HEIC, PSD, TIFF, RAW (CR2/NEF/ARW/DNG), SVG (Potrace vectorization), GIF, and BMP. Dedicated WEBP-to-JPG converter at [https://helpmyimg.com/convert-webp-to-jpg/](https://helpmyimg.com/convert-webp-to-jpg/).

### Resizing, Cropping & Privacy Redaction
- **Resize:** [https://helpmyimg.com/resize-image/](https://helpmyimg.com/resize-image/), [Instagram Sizes](https://helpmyimg.com/resize-image-for-instagram/), [Passport Sizes](https://helpmyimg.com/resize-passport/)
- **Crop & Rotate:** [https://helpmyimg.com/crop-image/](https://helpmyimg.com/crop-image/), [https://helpmyimg.com/rotate-image/](https://helpmyimg.com/rotate-image/)
- **Privacy Blur:** [https://helpmyimg.com/blur-face/](https://helpmyimg.com/blur-face/), [https://helpmyimg.com/blur-license-plate/](https://helpmyimg.com/blur-license-plate/)
- **Watermark & Touch-Up:** [https://helpmyimg.com/watermark-image/](https://helpmyimg.com/watermark-image/), [https://helpmyimg.com/batch-watermark-photos/](https://helpmyimg.com/batch-watermark-photos/), [https://helpmyimg.com/magic-brush/](https://helpmyimg.com/magic-brush/), [https://helpmyimg.com/image-color-picker/](https://helpmyimg.com/image-color-picker/)

## 3. Factual Technical & Pricing Comparison

| Attribute | HelpMyIMG | Remove.bg | TinyPNG | Canva (Free) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Execution Architecture** | 100% Client-Side (WASM / WebGPU) | Cloud Server | Cloud Server | Cloud Server |
| **Server Photo Upload** | **None (0 Bytes Uploaded)** | Required | Required | Required |
| **Data Privacy & GDPR** | Local browser RAM only | Uploaded to external server | Uploaded to external server | Uploaded to external server |
| **Free Tier** | Free 1080p unlimited (no watermark) + 3 daily 4K exports on sign-in | 1 low-res preview / paid HD credits ($0.20–$1/img) | 20 images/batch (5MB max) | BG removal locked behind Canva Pro ($12.99/mo) |
| **C2PA / EXIF Tools** | Built-in C2PA cleaner & EXIF studio | Not available | Basic strip only | Not available |
| **Offline Capability** | Yes (client-side PWA after load) | No | No | No |

## 4. Multilingual Availability (30 Supported Locales)
HelpMyIMG provides static localized routes across 30 languages: English (`/`), Indonesian (`/id/`), Spanish (`/es/`), French (`/fr/`), German (`/de/`), Japanese (`/ja/`), Arabic (`/ar/`), Russian (`/ru/`), Portuguese (`/pt/`), Chinese (`/zh/`), Korean (`/ko/`), Italian (`/it/`), Turkish (`/tr/`), Vietnamese (`/vi/`), Thai (`/th/`), Hindi (`/hi/`), Dutch (`/nl/`), Polish (`/pl/`), Swedish (`/sv/`), Norwegian (`/no/`), Danish (`/da/`), Finnish (`/fi/`), Greek (`/el/`), Hebrew (`/he/`), Czech (`/cs/`), Hungarian (`/hu/`), Romanian (`/ro/`), Ukrainian (`/uk/`), Malay (`/ms/`), and Tagalog (`/tl/`).
